options.oldanimations.title: Old Animations
options.oldanimations.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, every animation below falls back to vanilla.
options.oldanimations.sword_blocking.too: Hold use with a sword to show the old blocking pose. Visual only - swords still do not block damage in 26.2.
options.oldanimations.block_hit.tooltip: Keep playing the swing arc while blocking, the way 1.7 did.
options.oldanimations.third_person_block: Also pose the arm in F5 view. Applies to your own player only - the server never reports other players as blocking.
options.oldanimations.block_with_axes.to: Allow the blocking pose for axes as well as swords.
options.oldanimations.old_sneak_pose.too: Third-person crouch posed the 1.7 way: legs raised, head barely lowered, body and arms left alone.
options.oldanimations.old_sneak_camera.t: The 1.7 crouch curve: instant going down, eased coming back up. 26.2 eases both ways, 1.8 snapped both ways.
options.oldanimations.old_block_arm_pose: Drop the 30 degree inward yaw and head tracking modern blocking adds to the arm. Also affects shields.
options.oldanimations.armor_hurt_tint.to: Tint armour red with its wearer when they take a hit. 26.2 only reddens bare skin, so armoured players barely flinch.
options.oldanimations.no_health_flash.to: 1.7 hearts did not flash white when you took or regained damage.
options.oldanimations.hide_attack_indica: Hide the attack cooldown indicator, which 1.7 had no equivalent of. Vanilla can also do this under Controls > Attack Indicator.
options.oldanimations.fixed_swing_durati: Pin every swing to 6 ticks. Most items already use 6, so this only changes items with a custom swing duration.
Skip the equip animation and put a newly selected item straight in your hand. Not 1.7 (1.7 had the same ramp 26.2 does), just tighter to switch mid-fight.
options.oldanimations.instant_unsneak.to: Snap the camera back up on release instead of easing over about four ticks. Not 1.7 (1.7 eased), but the ease is the part of the sneak that reads as sluggish. Turn it off for the accurate curve.
options.oldanimations.block_slowdown.too: 1.7 cut movement to 20% and stopped sprinting while an item was in use. This is the only setting here that is not purely visual: it changes where you actually go. Off by default, since blocking gives you no damage reduction in 26.2 to pay for it.
options.oldanimations.hide_arrow_trail.t: Drop the crit particle stream behind arrows you fired. A preference, not a restoration -- 1.7 had the same trail. Other players' arrows keep theirs.
Bow punching, and block-hitting with a drawn bow. 1.7 allowed this by never checking; 26.2 blocks it. WARNING: this is the one setting that sends attacks a vanilla client would have swallowed, which is what server anticheats look for. Your call.
options.oldanimations.block_mining_swing: Keep the swing cycling while you hold attack on a block during a block, even when the server refuses the break. Local animation only, no swing packet is sent.
How far the camera drops when you crouch. 1.7 dropped 0.08, 26.2 drops 0.35. Anything below 0.35 puts the camera above the eye that block and entity picking starts from, so the crosshair sits that far high while crouched.
options.oldanimations.predict_crits.tool: Spawn crit particles locally on any falling hit, the way 1.7 and 1.8 critted. 26.2 gates crits behind the attack cooldown server-side. WARNING: these particles say "1.8 would have critted", not "this dealt crit damage", so they can disagree with what the server did.
Drop the white sweep arc. The sweep is a 1.9 addition and it is why spam-clicking looks like the game is choosing between several swings -- the arm itself is unchanged from 1.7.
options.oldanimations.no_view_bobbing.to: Switch off view bobbing. Not a restoration -- 26.2's bob is byte-for-byte 1.7's -- but 26.2 no longer surfaces the vanilla View Bobbing option.
options.oldanimations.no_fov_effects.too: Stop the field of view moving when your speed does. Sprinting, speed potions and flying all leave it alone. Here because 26.2 no longer surfaces the vanilla FOV Effects slider.
options.oldanimations.block_transition.t: How long the sword takes to travel between the swing and the block pose. Instant is what 1.7 did -- there the travel you see is the swing arc winding down. A short fade smooths the hit-to-block change; a long one never finishes if you click fast, and the sword floats.
options.oldanimations.debug_readout.tool: Show a one-line state readout on the action bar while blocking. Diagnostic only -- for working out why an animation fires on one server and not another.
options.oldanimations.category.feedback: Combat Feedback - what a hit looks like
options.oldanimations.category.gameplay: Gameplay - these change what you send
options.oldanimations.hide_eat_finish.to: Drop the burst of food particles that fires the moment you finish eating. Not a 26.2 quirk -- 1.7 spawned the same 16-particle burst. It trails behind you because it is spawned at your eye and you keep moving.
Keep the arm swinging mid-bow-draw or mid-gapple, as 1.7 did -- it applied the swing rotations unconditionally. Needs Attack While Using An Item to have anything to draw.
